nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Skill subsystem's core contract: SkillMeta (frozen metadata dataclass) and SkillBase (abstract base class with on_load/on_unload lifecycle hooks and tool/prompt slots that every skill implements).
nodes.languageNotes: SkillMeta uses @dataclass for declarative metadata records; SkillBase defines the lifecycle + binding protocol expected of all concrete skills.

nodes.name: builtin.py
nodes.summary: Ships the project's default skill implementations, including MathSkill (a math assistant) backed by the advanced_math tool, which performs safe AST-based arithmetic evaluation rather than eval().
nodes.languageNotes: advanced_math walks the parsed AST via a recursive _eval over ast.BinOp / UnaryOp / Constant nodes to evaluate arithmetic without exposing eval()/exec().

nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Implements SkillRegistry, the central registry/singleton that registers, loads, and unloads Skill classes (delegating tool registration on load), plus the @skill decorator for declarative SkillMeta-driven registration.
nodes.languageNotes: The @skill decorator returns a closure capturing a SkillMeta; the closure runs at class-definition time so a skill is registered simply by being imported.

nodes.name: SkillMeta
nodes.summary: Dataclass capturing a skill's name, description, version, tags, author, and enabled-by-default flag, used as the canonical descriptor passed to the registry.

nodes.name: SkillBase
nodes.summary: Abstract base class defining the skill lifecycle (on_load/on_unload), tool/prompt bindings, and a describe() accessor that returns the skill's metadata snapshot.

nodes.name: advanced_math
nodes.summary: Recursive AST-based arithmetic evaluator supporting binary operations, unary operations, and constants on a parsed expression tree, raising on unsupported nodes to keep evaluation safe.

nodes.name: MathSkill
nodes.summary: Built-in math-assistant skill extending SkillBase, binding the advanced_math tool and a system prompt that steers the agent to compute precisely rather than guess.

nodes.name: SkillRegistry
nodes.summary: Central registry tracking registered and loaded skills; orchestrates load/unload lifecycle, delegates tool registration to the tool registry on load, and exposes lookup and listing helpers.

nodes.name: skill
nodes.summary: Declarative class decorator factory that builds a SkillMeta from the supplied kwargs and registers the decorated SkillBase subclass with the global (or supplied) registry via a returned closure.
